title: PhotoSplit Grid for Instagram
meta_description: Creates Giant Grids by Splitting your Photos & Post to Instagram.
full_description: PhotoSplit is the original and the most popular app to split your photos to grid and post them directly to Instagram.PhotoSplit lets you slice any picture into a 1x2, 1x3, 2x3, 3x3, 4x3 & 5x3 grid while keeping it in high resolution. It then quickly lets you post the split images to Instagram to show it as one big photo on your profile.With PhotoSplit, you can zoom in, move, or even rotate your photo to instantly see how it will look like on your Instagram profile.• Choose from variety of grid options: 1x2, 1x3, 2x3, 3x3, 4x3 & 5x3• Keeps images in high resolution. Does not reduce quality after splitting.• Ability to rotate photos• Share images to Instagram without having to save first• Option to save to your phone gallery• Send any image from your phone or while browsing directly to the PhotoSplit app.
